inputs.name: PickerPreviewService.constructor.service
inputs.description: The provider-switch service instance passed to the tool dispatcher for POST `/tools` requests. It is not used for GET `/preview`.

inputs.name: PickerPreviewService.constructor.html
inputs.description: Static markup or an asynchronous supplier of markup used for GET `/preview`. The service uses it only on that route and replaces the first exact `<body>` with a body carrying the `data-picker-preview` attribute with value `true`.

inputs.name: PickerPreviewService.constructor.origin
inputs.description: The configured URL origin compared by exact string equality with each request URL origin and with the Origin header for POST `/tools`. A mismatch returns HTTP 403.

inputs.name: PickerPreviewService.fetch.request
inputs.description: The Fetch API request to dispatch. Its URL origin is checked first; only GET `/preview` and POST `/tools` are handled, and POST `/tools` also requires an Origin header exactly equal to the configured origin.

outputs.name: PickerPreviewService.fetch
outputs.description: Resolves to the HTTP response for the request. Matching-origin GET `/preview` returns no-store HTML with a Content Security Policy; matching-origin POST `/tools` returns tool JSON or a 400 JSON error, while rejected hosts or origins get 403 and unmatched methods or paths get 404.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: For POST `/tools`, the handler throws `Error('Request too large')` when the body string length exceeds 16,000 and `Error('The preview only accepts its synthetic session.')` for a truthy `arguments.session_id` other than `preview-session`; `respond` catches these and returns HTTP 400 JSON with `error: Invalid preview request.`.

errors.name: unknown
errors.description: If the asynchronous HTML supplier rejects while GET `/preview` is handled, `fetch` propagates that rejection unchanged; the implementation does not constrain its name or value.

inputs.name: PickerPreviewService.fetch.request
inputs.description: The Fetch API request to dispatch. Its URL origin is checked first; only GET `/preview` and POST `/tools` are handled, and POST `/tools` also requires an Origin header exactly equal to the configured origin.

errors.description: If the asynchronous HTML supplier rejects while GET `/preview` is handled, `fetch` propagates that rejection unchanged; the implementation does not constrain its name or value. Failures inside POST `/tools` handling are caught and returned as HTTP 400 JSON.
